title: predicatory-confluence
description: Joinability of divergent settling paths: a predicatory comparison specialized to the case where two settling rewrites from a common value reach a common joining value. Generated by refining predicatory-comparison with the confluence (Church-Rosser) discipline.

orderConfluence.description: a common knowledge-order upper bound exists; the ambient preorder supplies the canonical candidate z = u join_k w

operationalConfluence.description: the order upper bound u join_k w is actually reachable from both branches by the admitted settling morphisms; true for posit- and merge-generated paths (each is a leq_k-increasing evidence addition), but must be proved per rule language for arbitrary closure disciplines

joiningWitness.description: optional proof-object level: the witness z together with the posit, closure, or merge steps needed to reach it from each branch, not merely the joined value
